items.text: What's new: the star button in the header shows what changed each day
Streamer pages have an All time option in the Session dropdown, so you can see someone's best runs on a level across every session
Best first sorts by how long the run was. Completions like 85%-100% don't jump ahead of longer runs anymore
The Linked to VOD stat is now On stream / off stream
Runs without a VOD say Not live, with a note explaining the streamer probably wasn't streaming
Streamer pages open on the level they played last, and the level list can be sorted by Recent or Most attempts
Level pages: every level with its startpos copies, its AREDL rank, creators and verifier, who beat it and the best runs
Clicking a level name in a session opens its level page, and practice runs show up there too
New home page with the top runs of the week ranked by the AREDL, completions and levels
AREDL thumbnails on level cards, search results, level pages and sessions
v1.0.5: the mod doesn't save or upload in the middle of an attempt anymore. It waits until you die or pause, so it can't cause lag
v1.0.5: keeps 50 sessions per level instead of 20
v1.0.4: updates itself when you open GD
v1.0.3: hide a level from the website while it keeps tracking. Showing it again uploads everything
v1.0.3: a new session starts after 30 minutes away from a level instead of 120
Noclip runs show under their own Noclip tab with their accuracy and deaths
Report bug button in the header for bugs and feedback
Pages load from a cache, so updates don't get paused by GitHub's limits
Link previews when the site is shared on Discord or X
New GD Rewind logo
Noclip runs are saved with their accuracy and death count, and kept out of normal stats
